Five ways to cut your electricity bill

Cleaning solar panels once a quarter can recover up to 15 percent of lost output, according to a 2024 study. Dust and pollen form an insulating layer that blocks sunlight before it reaches the cells.

Set your air conditioner to 24 degrees Celsius instead of 20; each degree warmer saves roughly 6 percent on cooling costs. A smart power strip stops phantom loads from consoles and routers, which can account for 10 percent of a household bill.
